body_markdown:
Renters know that[Manhattan](https://www.renthop.com/nyc/manhattan-apartments) is expensive. Summer is ending and median prices for an apartment in the borough has finally dropped to[$5,395](https://www.renthop.com/average-rent-in/manhattan-new-york-ny) this month. Renters can browse the best Manhattan listings in September of 2026 for under $3,867 to find competitive rental opportunities.


During the summer, renters had plenty of competition from other renters for great apartments. However, now that we’re slowly approaching fall, renters must act quickly to take advantage of the available inventory due to competition from other renters. The following Manhattan listings in September of 2026 for rent under $3,867 offer laundry access in the building, private balcony access, fitness centers, and more.


---


## Best Manhattan listings in September of 2026 under $3,867


### [1. 888 Main Street #1217](https://www.renthop.com/listings/888-main-street/1217/75813009/show)


Neighborhood:[Roosevelt Island](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/roosevelt-island-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,867


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 7.93%


First up this month, we have this one bedroom apartment located in Roosevelt Island. The landlord is currently offering one month free rent on a 12 month lease, making this an affordable deal. Future residents will fall in love with the apartments various features but most of all the building amenities such as its fitness center, laundry room, swimming pool, business center, etc.


### [2. 507 East 13th Street #2](https://www.renthop.com/listings/507-east-13th-street/2/76687188/show)

Price: $3,400


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath

Next up, check out this East Village apartment with a king-sized bedroom, brand new hardwood flooring, and french doors. The unit is located in a well maintained walk-up building and is located close by to Tompkins Square Park, NYU, and other great restaurants and bars in the East Village. There is a super living within the building for quick maintenance needs.

## Methodology


Released on a monthly basis, the RentHop Best Deal series aims to provide renters with useful market insights and a chance to identify rental gems currently available on the market. These Manhattan best deals are hand-selected by the team at[RentHop](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) based on a few factors, including layout, apartment size, features, and, more importantly, price.


Note that, given the fast-paced nature of the rental market in New York, certain listings may receive applications and be taken off the market within days. If you are interested in scheduling a showing or have further questions, please make sure to submit an inquiry via the inquiry submission form located on the listing page.
